# National High Adventure Base Jobs

The BSA’s four national high-adventure bases are looking for quality staff
members.

The Florida Sea Base, Northern Tier High Adventure Base, Summit Bechtel
Reserve, and Philmont Scout Ranch annually seek applications from qualified
men and women. Each season, for example, Philmont alone employs more than
1,100 individuals, from trail-guide rangers to backcountry program staffers to
base camp and Philmont Training Center support people. Likewise, Northern Tier
and the Florida Sea Base fill similar seasonal slots. Applicants must be 18 or
older; previous Scouting experience and attendance at a high-adventure base
are helpful but not required.

Get details and applications from each base:  
**  
[Sea Base](http://bsaseabase.org/Resources/Employment)**  
P.O. Box 1906  
Islamorada, FL 33036  
305-664-4173

**[Northern Tier](https://www.ntier.org/jobs/)**  
P.O. Box 509  
Ely, MN 55731-0509  
218-365-4811

[**Summit Bechtel Reserve**](https://www.summitbsa.org/jobs/)  
2550 Jack Furst Drive  
Glen Jean, WV 25846  
304-465-2800

[**Philmont Scout Ranch**](https://www.philmontscoutranch.org/jobs/)  
17 Deer Run Rd  
Cimarron, NM 87714  
505-376-2281
